<style>
.team-grid {
  display: grid;

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  /* border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; */

}

  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}

  display: block;

}

  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;

  margin-bottom: 0px;

}

  padding: 1.25rem;

}

Meet out Senckenberg-associated members! 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)
path.team <- list.files("chapter/project/team", full.names = T) %>% stringr::str_subset("(?<!template)\\.qmd$")

path.team.sorted <- c(path.team %>% stringr::str_subset("saskia_brix"), path.team %>% stringr::str_subset("saskia_brix", T) %>% sort())

frontmatter.ls <- map(path.team.sorted, ~zhutilsr::read_md_frontmatter(.x) %>% yaml::yaml.load())
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false

# Pair each person's frontmatter with their corresponding page link
team_cards <- map2(frontmatter.ls, path.team.sorted, function(person, path) {
  
  # Construct full name (filtering out NULL or empty title/name parts)
  name_parts <- c(person$name_title, person$name_first, person$name_last)
  name_parts <- name_parts[!is.na(name_parts) & nzchar(trimws(name_parts))]
  full_name <- paste(name_parts, collapse = " ")
  
  # Convert .qmd path to relative .html link (adjust if your site structure differs)
  profile_url <- str_replace(basename(path), "\\.qmd$", ".html") %>% paste0("./team/", .)
  
  # Build the card HTML
  div(
    class = "team-card",
    
    # Profile Image (linked to their individual page)
    if (!is.null(person$profile_picture) && nzchar(person$profile_picture)) {
      a(
        href = profile_url,
        class = "team-card-img-link",
        img(
          src = person$profile_picture,
          alt = paste("Portrait of", full_name),
          class = "team-card-img"
        )
      )
    },
    
    # Text Content
    div(
      class = "team-card-body",
      h3(
        class = "team-card-name",
        a(href = profile_url, full_name)
      ),
      if (!is.null(person$positiion) && nzchar(person$positiion)) {
        div(class = "team-card-position", person$positiion)
      },
      if (!is.null(person$description_short) && nzchar(person$description_short)) {
        p(class = "team-card-desc", person$description_short)
      }
    )
  )
})

# Render the responsive grid container

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
div(class = "team-grid", team_cards)
```
